start: Exact binary input g0,y0 for the original eight named impact failures, time and h. Use no old end state or reference force in the update.
order: First publish the primary witness; a fresh process consumes only its saved end state and advances one more full h under identical conditions. Independently audit both. Open the other seven only on primary acceptance; each has its own exact witness inlet and an actual cold successor. Beyond T, successor is a readback diagnostic, not a reference window extension.
force: Fixed A=1, impact M=2m,F=0, same fit and prior active partition. Three law evaluations per internal piece: left traction L, provisional right under constant L, corrected right using the resulting affine predictor. Each evaluation rounds the stated nonnegative SC-L1 law to a binary64 force. The last right value R and L define a single affine traction on the piece. No reference force, state repair or special-case tail cutoff.
state: Publish t,g,y=1+d*v. Each scalar has its nearest finite binary64 word and a canonical exact signed rational remainder. The word plus remainder is the scalar's authoritative value for this experiment. Construct J,B,v,g from the same traction. Every piece reads back serialized bytes. On a separate interpreter and with no archived seed passed to the successor kernel, read the original-step endpoint from disk and use it for the next force evaluation. Compare the same traction using word-only readback.
strict: Exact recovered inertial force equals both nonnegative force endpoints on every piece; the path between them is affine in force. Independent integration of the force equals both moments of the read-back state on every piece and the original step. Verify continuity, exact whole-path core and strictly positive active compression/rate, original step impulse, gap, speed, peak, constitutive moment/prefix and positive energy gates. Only original-window rows have reference columns. Across each contiguous witness/successor pair within the original window sum positive work and impulse errors; no claim for unsimulated parts of T.
tail_guard: additionally require a rigorous all-time absolute traction-law discrepancy no larger than 1/100 of the positive lower law bound on each tail piece. Zero force cannot pass by being below the inherited absolute tolerances.
negative_controls: remove both remainders and rebuild canonical packet with same force
swap distinct left/right forces to preserve impulse but change time moment
scope: HOST scalar diagnostic; original source, budgets, reference material and eight witness inputs stay fixed. Assess the new state representation and its actual size explicitly. No joint runtime/native acceptance.
